source: Original procedural synthesis (numpy/scipy); no recordings or generated-audio services.

layers.thunk: pneumatic launch: 118 Hz -> 46 Hz sine body, 2nd harmonic, 900 Hz lowpassed air burst
layers.whine: blade spin-up: 620 Hz -> 2050 Hz exponential saw sweep, 0.9 kHz..3 kHz bandpass, swell then release
layers.shing: steel tail: 7 inharmonic partials 2.87..9.6 kHz with 0.6..3 Hz beating, 5.5 kHz highpassed scrape

encoding: Ogg Opus, mono 48 kHz, 96 kbit/s (local ffmpeg has no libvorbis)
